referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the production of a passenger car glider. The glider includes: the body of the car, the steering, braking and suspension system, tyres, cockpit equipment (seats, belts, etc.) and non propulsion related electronics. Entries are given per kg glider. The data has been derived for a glider of about 800kg, corresponding to a compact size car of approximately 1200 to 1400kg.; UUID: 7ac1e22b-caaf-35bc-972f-827ae4d49296
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset takes as input the raw materials and the energy inputs required for the production process and includes the production facility. The dataset returns the finished glider as well as the output scrap fractions from the production process.
referenceFunction.name: Glider, for passenger car

technology.text: The dataset is based on averages over passenger car technologies spanning from 2000 to 2010 which are expected to be representative up to 2015.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Average of material compositions published in literature between 2000 and 2010.
